description: Pass `'--as-pid-1'` to `bwrap` in `sandbox_args` so `bwrap` ($P_1$) does not fork an unwaited `do_init` ($P_2$) via `event_fd`, and instead waits on the sandbox PID-1 process directly via `waitpid(P_2)` (which in `kernel/exit.c` cannot return until `cgroup_exit(P_2)` has already completed). Keeps L711 (`read_numbers(group.path/'cgroup.events').get('populated',0)==0`) 100% strict and immediate with zero polling.

exact_edit_in_launch_or_sandbox_args.new_literal_in_launch_L662: bwrap_opts=args[:separator]+([] if '--as-pid-1' in args[:separator] else ['--as-pid-1']);fd=sealed_memfd('sdk-bwrap-argv',b'\0'.join(x.encode() for x in bwrap_opts)+b'\0');args=bwrap_opts+['--',*cmd]
